title: The Cartographer's Method
description: A Signature-original algorithm: explore by mapping. Every discovery is drawn, and the map becomes the next expedition's plan.

title: The Question Chain
description: A Signature-original algorithm: each discovery must generate three new questions before moving on.

title: Reverse Archaeology
description: A Signature-original algorithm: bury built creations for a partner to excavate and interpret.

title: The Blind Survey
description: A Signature-original algorithm: explore a new toy by touch alone first, then by sight.

title: Echo Exploration
description: A Signature-original algorithm: explore in pairs; one explores, the other echoes observations back.

title: The Fifty Uses
description: A Signature-original algorithm: find fifty uses for one ordinary object.

title: Night Shift
description: A Signature-original algorithm: explore familiar toys in the dark with safe lights.

title: The Living Lab Notebook
description: A Signature-original algorithm: every exploration is logged like a scientist's notebook.
